steps.name: fu2-2-art-floor
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && set -o pipefail && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'ArtRefusal|ArtPrefixRefusal|Svg|BundleArt|SiteImport|Contract|Design' . && make contract >/dev/null && test -z "$(git -C $R diff --name-only -- tools/orb-manager/contract)" && grep -q 'func artPrefixRefusal' sitelimits.go && cd $R && make check-pictures && make check-editor && make check-web && sh docs/specs/s3-gotest.sh && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/fu2-1-svg-parse -- apps tools/orb-manager/editor.go tools/orb-manager/security.go tools/orb-manager/release.go tools/orb-manager/designs.go tools/orb-manager/libentries.go)"

steps.name: fu2-3-www-and-sdkdoc
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && set -o pipefail && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'SiteAllowed|SiteImport|ResolveOrigin|ThemeOrigin' . && cd $R && grep -q 'www.orb-os.net' tools/orb-manager/sitelimits.go && grep -q 'unsafe-eval' apps/README.md && grep -qi 'support@1' apps/README.md && make check-hub && sh docs/specs/s3-gotest.sh && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/fu2-1-svg-parse -- tools/orb-manager/contract apps/clock apps/flights apps/weather apps/radar apps/color_picker)"

steps.name: fu2-4-rename-prompt
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && set -o pipefail && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'Rename|ThemeName|Design|LibEntry|Keep|Forget' . && node --check web/runtime/theme@1/session.js && grep -q 'func checkNewName' libentries.go && test -z "$(git diff delegate/fu2-1-svg-parse -- libentries.go | grep -E '^[+-].*func (checkNewName|checkThemeName)')" && cd $R && make check-rename-live 2>&1 | tail -3 | grep -qE 'rename-live: ([0-9]+)/\1 passed' && make check-editor && make check-web && sh docs/specs/s3-gotest.sh && test -z "$(git diff --name-only delegate/fu2-1-svg-parse -- tools/orb-manager/contract apps)"
